--- Page 5 --- AGANCHENGANI [PREFACE] Ia kitapo scgipa golporangko haida mitamrang Englishchi segipa kitaprangoniko poraiman'enggnok ine anga bebe raa.
Indakgiparang ia kitapko nimrakon katta- rangni bichongko uina nengjawa ine anga chanchia.
Jeba cngbo.
English ku'sikko poraina man'pagijagiparangna ia kitap bi'sa poraina gisik nangatbeani onggen ine anga chanchia.
Indakgiparangna miksongbate anga ia kitap bi'sako seaha.
a kitap bisako seanio angni gisik nangatna sikania.

skangni pagitchamrang maikai Kristona sakki on'anio aro Nama Kattako aganprakanio an'tangtangni bcbe ra'anio mangrake kimkim chadengaha, uko da'ororoni kristian- rangna nambegipa mcsokani ong'chongmotgen ine ka'donge.
uamangni bebc ra'anio bilakanina didiatani aro mangrak- atani ongchongmotgen ine ka'dongsoa.

Ia kitap badiaba gipin ku'sikoniko pe'skaani ine anga aganna manja: maina ia ki'tapko sena skang anga kingsa kinggni ki'taprangko poraichengesa, iarang namgni ong- begcn aro daororoni A'chik Kristianrangna poraina namgipa ong'gen ine chanchic, katta bichongko ra'esan ku'siktangchi ba kattatangchisan scaha.
Uni gimin seanirango kattarang aro maiba miksonganirangko uigijanirang ba talgijanirang donggen ine anga chanchia.

Unbaksaba ian skanggipa chapa ka'ani (First Edition) ongcngpitini gimin gualani- rangko dongatgija daksrangna aro kattarangko rongtalat- srangna man'kuja, indiba iako gipin chango chapa ka'taiosa nambatatna aro rongtalbatatna chol ong'aignok.
Uni gimin poraigipako indake molmola je, kattarangko jeaigija aro --- Page 6 --- (1i ) seanirang namja inaigija, batesa ia golponi maiba nama- uiatchengna sika.
Ia kitap bi'sao je golponi gimin seaha, uani substan- ccko anga ka'mao bang'gija sce mesoksona nangnike seaha.
lan indake ong'a.
la golpo Kristoni mondoliko rikna abachenggipa skanggipa ritcha bilsirangni somoio a'sel ong'anirang ong'a.
Agilsak gimikko changsao Rome a'song bilakbee sason ka'gipa ongaha.
Ja a'songni bilakbatgipa rajarangni giscpo Nero rajaba dalbatgiparangoni saksa ong'achim.
Uni sason ka'ani somoio Kristoni Nama Kattarang jelro- roaha aro Europeni bangbata bakrangon ia Nama Katta giproroangaha.
Palestineoni abachenge, aganprakgiparang pilak mitchiani, a'rikani aro champenganirangko chilprete kamrangko ka'beaha.
Uamangoni mongsongbatgipa Watata Pitor aro Watata Paul ongachim.
lamang sakgnian Rome songjinmaona sokangc, uano bang'en gisikpilatanirangko dakna man'aha aro uamang sakgnian Romeni sason ka'gipa Nero Raja dalgipani jakchi so'otako manaha.
Watata Fitor bjkpile chisolo datkapako man'e siaha aro Watata Paul uan tonualchi sko sotako man'e siaha.
Uamangni an'chichi Romeo pangkamgipa mondoliko rikaha.
Nero Raja ka'namgijagipa, sikatango tanggipa, chan- chiao aro cholonoba tik ong'gijagipa aro namjabatgipa- rangoni saksa ongachim ine bang'a serikanirango poraina man'a.
Rome a'song gimikon ia gital dol Kristianrangni kosako namen uisretbeani gnangchim.
Uamang mande- rangoniko uamangni namgija kamrangni gimin aro misilgni kamrangko dakani a'sel jinmaoniko rikgalako man'gimin dol ine Romeni manderang chanchiachim.
Indake uamangni obosta a'bachengao ong'achim.
Nero raja sason ka'aniko jako ra'on, ua changsao misilbegni pilakni dakgija kamko dakaha.
Chong'motan ua' --- Page 7 --- (ii) Rome songjinmako namnikjae aro mitchie songjinma gimikkon so'goptokaha, aro an'tang namnika gita rik uko Neropolis ba Neroni songjinma mingskana chanchiachim.

Manderang a Neroan ia songjinmako so'aha ine uie, uni kosako chaktogija matnangani dongon aro janggina kenani- rangba ongkatbaon, ua kengokenung kristianrangni kosako aiao inmanpile misilgipa matnanganirangko banaic.
uarangko ka'onangenggipa jinmana prochar ka'ate aro ia kristianrangsa Romeko soraha ine jangate, uamangni kosako chaktopilgijagipa sastirangko aro so'otanirangko dakdilaha.
Misilgipa singhorangna, matcharangna, mikmalgijagipa achakrangna Niramo aale rodilaha.
Chisolrango datkapaha.
krongrango katate wa'alrangchi so'e roaha, chrirangchi goe 1oaha, chichaenggipa torango galpruc roaha, tonualrangchi sko sote roaha.
Indake ma'manti chaktopilgijagipa duk aro sastirangko dosi grigipa kristianrangni kosakona ra'bae hajal hajal manderangko so'ote ka onangenggipa Romeni manderangna mesoke roaha.
Kosako aganbagimin duk aro sastirangko kristianrang maikai kadongbce aro mamung kenani gri aro kusi ong'c kristona sakki ong'c chakchikaha ia kitap bi'sao scaha.
Indake kristianrangko dosi griko dosi pote matnangdile a'rikaniko dakaniranga mikbuanisan ongbataia inc nikna mangen.
Saksa Roman panle.

sipaini dilgipa, nitogipa aro pante daknanggipako Rani an tangan mikchae aro unbaksa kragija namgija dakna sikon, ua pante indakgiparangko dakna namnikja aro ua panteara saksa nitobegipa Kristian me'trakosa mikchaskaon ua me'tra ua panteko kristian ong'kuja dipet mikcha-ka'sagrikbeoba bia ka'na jechake bon'chotao, ia a'rikbeani salrango sakgnian so'otako man'na patoko dongmitingo, pante gisik pirosa uamang Watata Pitorni jakchi patok noko bia ka'atako man'c.

attamo Niramona so'otako man'na rimongkatbaon maikai uamang ong'ronggija a'selrangchi Nero rajani bilko --- Page 8 --- (iv) bnekatsrange aro Neroni a'songni chakataniko ongate Neroko aro uni namgija kamrangko gimaatani cholko ong- ataha, iarangni gimin poraina man'gen.

Ia kitapo seanirang gimikon maikai kristianrang ken- begnini salakimo janggi tangna nangachim aro chaktopil- gija duk aro sastiko ka'dingsmite chakaha aro Siana kenjaha, batesa Siako ka'dingsmitc ra'chakaha uko mesoka.
Ia duk aro sastiko ra'bae uamangko a'rikaniranga maikai Kristoni mondoliko kimkim pangraksrange donaha uko tale mesoka.
Kristianrangni bcbe ra'ani aro mondolini kimkim pangrakania a'rikanio pangnan ong'batronga ine ia kitap bi'sako ponaiachi nikna mana.
Jan Kristianrangni bebe ra'ani maikai ong'na nanga ukoba mesokani ong'bea.
Poraigiparang ia kitap bi'sako name gisik nange poraiode iano bang'cn skianiko man'gen aro bebe ra'atangko kimkim rakkina sakoni bilkoba man'gen ine anga ka'dong chongmota.
Ia ki'tap bi'sako poraigipa sakantinan salgioni bil aro gisikni nikchipaniko pattichina angni sikpaa.
WILSON K.
MARAK.
--- Page 9 --- OIDHAI-I MARCUS BRITAINONI RE-BAPILA Songjinma uamangni mikkangonjok.

“Da'osa ian Rome- bebejokai!” Bilsi gittamna kingking ia CHIBRIGIPA SIPAINI DOL rake kamko ka'aha, gramchiaha; ama man'aniko chakchikaha, amani rasongko man'aha aro a'gilsakni adhagrik ong'pilgipa a'songrangko ame rasong- rangko man'aha.
Ian chong'motjok!
Agisio nikbing- bangani (mirage） jagring ongjajok, jeon ncng'takanina ka'donggramaianio uamang siani-tanganiko ka'dingstekaha.
Uamang tusie jumangrangko nikmitingo Britonrangni walo rang'gitik inchroe chagroparangna pilni pil ranggitik chakate warachakna nangaha aro indimangba uamang an'tanglangko amaha ine uijachim.
Salni teng'sua rot garirangni aro do'gamdotni bimang- rangko dakgipa tamani silrango nangchakengachim aro Rome a'songni Sorkarini chinko dakchapgipa sipairangni danilrango tengchakengachim.
Appian sorok, jean bilsi hajal- gnirangna skangonin mingsingbatgipa sorok ong'baaha, ua rama gita mikchikkime re-baenggipa sipairangni kosako a'dumurang tang'doe ga'akdapengachim.

Rim'gopa man'gipa nokkolrangko garirango kachape garirangko saldoenggipa- rangko betsmitrangchi doksipsipe re'na aratenggipa gari- rangko amgija ga'akgoppile saldoenggiparang maikai amjae rang'sitdatdatengachim.
--- Page 10 --- ROMESONGJINMAKOKAMANI Marcus Vinicius ia Chrbrigipa sipaini dolni Commander (Dilgipa) onga.

Ua sipai panteni rot garitangko nengrae an'pilate niaton sipairangni akimbriona dobatokengako niate nikwatna man'gen." ine uni gnigipa dilgipa Fabius Nervana an'tangni rot gariko salenggipa gurerangko dokjoljole aganengachim.
Indake rot garirang apsan apsan dake a'kim- briona sokdimeon songjinmako chugimik mikkangtangtango nikaha.
“Hiwa Rome dongengpiti !
Bilsi gittam - - ruut- bebeamo Favius !" ine Marcus aganengachim.
"Oe Marcus - - ruuta - - Philomena aro bi'sarang - - da'awalde noktango gipa mande - - ka'beaniko matchotaha.
Angade tusianikode am'jaenga.
ine Marcus aganmitingchachaon sipairang dolsa dobaengako niksoe "haida an'chingna re'dilgipako watatsoakon." ine agandapjolaha.
Dolko dilbaenggipa captain panteni ta'rake re'dobaengako uamang gario niso.
cngachim.
Ua rot gari ge'gnini sambaona sokeon Marcus- chipak re'bekbae salam ka'e inaha.“Salam Marcus Vinicius.
Raja dalgipa, kamal dalbatgipa, rongtalgipa Neroni bimungo." ine ua captain pante salam ka'aha.
"Angan Captain Flavius, Pretorian sipairangni pamong.
Na'simangni a'songko ama-cheanirang na'simang sokbana Romeona soksoaha, Commander.” ine ua aganaha.
"Chingaba sokningna sikbeengjok.
Hai, guretangtango gakate re'dilbojok" ine Marcus ua captainna aganengachim.
Flavius lekka dola kingsako ra'ongkate aganaha.

"Anga duk ong'a Commander, ango nang'na Rajani hukum donga." Marcus jajrenga gnang ua lekka dolako ra'e ta'rake paraie Captainni jakon uko on'pile, Bilsi gittam dakgrike ame re-baaniko namgipa rimchaksoani ian !" ine Marcus aganaha.
"Romeona napna hukum on'kujana kingking Romeni a'palon dongkuchina hukum onaha !" “Rome an'tangni dakgrikgiparangna ka'sara !" ine sipairangoni saksa chrikeng-
